title: 电源大比较：电池、电源模块、稳压电源
summary: 电池只给一组电源轨供电，下半区的 LED 就不亮。换成电源模块，上下两组轨道同时有电。
description: 三种常见电源：电池（电压由化学决定、有内阻、没有保护、只接一组轨道）、面包板电源模块（5 V / 3.3 V，同时给上下两组轨道供电）、实验室稳压电源（电压可调、能限流）。本课先用电池点下半区的 LED，发现它不亮，再换成电源模块点亮上下两半。

cards.title: 下半区的灯为什么不亮？
text: 先用**电池**供电，电池接在**上方**的电源轨。然后在面包板的**下半区**搭一条 LED 支路，接在**下方**的电源轨上。

cards.title: 三种电源，各有脾气
text: - **电池**：电压由化学决定（9 V 方块、AA 每节 1.5 V、CR2032 纽扣 3 V）。有**内阻**：电流越大，端电压越低。只有两根线，**只给一组轨道供电**——上下两组电源轨之间并不相通。
- **面包板电源模块**（如 MB102）：用 USB 取电，跳线帽选 5 V 或 3.3 V。它的针脚**同时插进上下两组电源轨**，所以哪一半都能就近取电。
- **实验室稳压电源**：电压连续可调，还能设定**限流**，接错线时能保护电路（第 1.10d 课专门讲）。

cards.title: 换成电源模块
text: 拿掉电池，插上电源模块，再在上半区也搭一条支路。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 用电池或稳压电源时，**下半区要用电，就用跳线把 tp↔bp、tn↔bn 连起来**。
- 电源模块的 + 要对准**红线**那条轨道，插反了等于把电源接反。
- 调试新电路时，能用稳压电源就用稳压电源，并把限流设小一点（如 50–100 mA）：接错了它会先“认输”，元件就安全。

en.title: Supplies compared: battery, power module, bench supply
en.summary: A battery powers only one pair of rails, so an LED on the lower half stays dark. A power module powers both pairs at once.
en.description: Three common supplies: a battery (voltage set by chemistry, internal resistance, no protection, one pair of rails), a breadboard power module (5 V / 3.3 V, powering the top and bottom rails at once) and a lab bench supply (adjustable voltage, current limit). This lesson first tries to light an LED on the lower half from a battery and finds it dark, then switches to the power module to light both halves.
steps: **Battery** (9 V): + in **`tp1`**, − in **`tn1`** — only the **top** pair of rails.
Lower half: **R2** (**`220 Ω`**) from the lower red rail **`bp6`** to **`j6`**.
**Green LED2**: long lead **`i6`**, short lead **`i9`**; blue **jumper** **`j9`** → **`bn9`** (the lower − rail). Is LED2 lit?
Pick Multimeter and put the red probe on **`bp10`** (the lower red rail). What does it read?
**Breadboard power module** in **`tp1`**, keep **5 V**: its four pins go into tp1, tn1, bp1 and bn1. LED2 lights up!
Top half: **R1** (**`220 Ω`**) **`tp6`** – **`b6`**; **yellow LED1** long lead **`c6`**, short lead **`c9`**; blue **jumper** **`a9`** → **`tn9`**. Press **Check my circuit**.
hints: The top and bottom rails are not connected: with the battery on the top rails only, the bottom rails have no power.
The power module goes in column 1, with its + lined up with the red-line rail.
tests: Both LEDs on, module output normal

cards.title: Why is the lower LED dark?
text: Power the board from a **battery** connected to the **top** rails. Then build an LED branch on the **lower half** of the board, on the **lower** rails.

cards.title: Three supplies, three tempers
text: - **Battery**: chemistry sets the voltage (9 V block, 1.5 V per AA, 3 V CR2032 coin cell). It has **internal resistance**: the more current, the lower its terminal voltage. Two wires only, so it **powers one pair of rails** — the top and bottom rails are not connected to each other.
- **Breadboard power module** (such as an MB102): powered from USB, a jumper selects 5 V or 3.3 V. Its pins go **into the top and bottom rails at once**, so both halves can draw power nearby.
- **Lab bench supply**: continuously adjustable voltage plus a **current limit** that protects the circuit when something is wired wrong (lesson 1.10d is all about it).

cards.title: Switch to the power module
text: Remove the battery, plug in the power module, and add a branch on the top half too.

cards.title: Take away
text: - With a battery or a bench supply, **power the lower half with jumpers tp↔bp and tn↔bn**.
- The power module's + must line up with the rail with the **red line**; reversed, it reverses your supply.
- Debugging a new circuit? Use a bench supply if you have one, with a low current limit (say 50–100 mA): if something is wrong it gives up first and your parts survive.

measurements.ask: With the battery, why did LED2 on the lower half stay dark?
choices: The battery's voltage was too low
The top and bottom rails are not connected; the battery fed only the top ones, so the lower rails floated
measurements.explain: The top and bottom rail pairs are separate strips. A battery has two wires and can feed only one pair; join the pairs with jumpers, or use a power module that plugs into both.

measurements.ask: Click the yellow LED1: the current in Properties
Click the green LED2: the current in Properties
measurements.explain: (5 − 2.1) / (220 + 12) ≈ 12.5 mA: the lower half is powered by the same module.

tests.name: 上下两个 LED 都亮，模块输出正常

measurements.ask: 用电池供电时，下半区的 LED2 为什么不亮？
choices: 上下两组电源轨不相通，电池只接了上方的轨道，下方轨道悬空
measurements.explain: 面包板上下两组电源轨是分开的金属条。电池只有两根线，只能给一组轨道供电；要么用跳线把两组接起来，要么用同时插两组的电源模块。

measurements.ask: 单击黄色 LED1：「属性」里的电流
单击绿色 LED2：「属性」里的电流

steps.text: 选「万用表」，红表笔点 **`bp10`**（下方红轨）。读数是什么？
**面包板电源模块**插 **`tp1`**，保持 **5 V**：四根针进入 tp1、tn1、bp1、bn1。LED2 亮了！

hints: 上下两组电源轨互相不通：电池只接上方时，下方轨道没有电。
电源模块要插在第 1 列，它的 + 对准红线轨道。
